description: Corrects one field Sergio read off a platform email, as crossing it out or retyping it in the parsed-email overlay does: field_key is the field (read the email's parsed fields first), and pass exactly one of corrected_value (the right value) or verdict 'not_in_source' (the email never said it). teach false means just this email, never the parsing rule. channel 'sms' for a platform's texted notice. This fixes the email, its booking and the linked contact. Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying; a repeat returns the first correction.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

name: correct_email_facts
title: Correct a field Sergio read off an email
